posts.title: The Class of 2026
posts.description: On Friday 20 November 2026 the new graduates of York St John were having their ceremony at York Minster. Why I think they are graduating into a much bleaker job market than I did in 2010, why the data does not add up, and why this is the time to build something or to go into research.

posts.title: The Office Used to Hire Everyone
posts.description: What happened to the people the sea employed is happening to the office now. Why the 9 to 5 goes first, what the layoffs and the return to office do to the tax base, and why you're not an employee any more, you're the boss.

posts.title: A Backbone for the Critical Thinkers
posts.description: A good critical thinker without a moral background is just a very good arguer. Notes that started in the ruins of Nicopolis, on what a good dictator would look like and how a society would have to be structured so it didn't need one.
